meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 OpenCode 当作新的智能体后端,通过 OpenCode 配置接入 OpenRouter、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek 等模型提供商,不再只走默认的 Claude 通道。
howto.when: 当你给某个智能体分组设置 provider 为 opencode,并配置好 OPENCODE_* 环境变量与密钥后,该分组的智能体运行时就会改用 OpenCode。

say.text: 帮我把当前分组的 provider 改成 opencode
配置 DeepSeek 作为我的模型提供商
把记忆迁移到新的 provider 下

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use OpenCode as an alternative agent backend, routing requests through OpenCode config to providers like OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek instead of the default Claude provider.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent group's provider is set to opencode and OPENCODE_* env vars plus credentials are configured; the group's runtime then switches to OpenCode.

say_en.text: Set my current group's provider to opencode
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update --provider opencode

say_en.text: Configure DeepSeek as my model provider
Migrate memory to the new provider
